description.value: Popina is a fast-casual canteen perched at the Ferry Dock on Granville Island, conceived by a team of celebrated Vancouver chefs who wanted to elevate street food with a lobster roll, fried chicken, falafel, and a flagship burger. The menu expands into local seafoods, specialty toasts, soft-serve, and salads, making it a compelling stop for cyclists passing through the Granville Island end of the Seawall. Being open-air and right on the waterfront, it fits naturally into a cycling day on Vancouver's waterfront routes.
